dct_description_sm: Since 2012, this case has been played 15095 times.

In the style of Tamagotchi (™) pets from years ago, this case can be designed to trigger with cries for help or needs for attention. This is to demonstrate how you can make a virtual scenario which demonstrates some of the principles around continuity of care, being on call etc. Also demonstrates how a needy case would escalate.
